response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced, versatile senior software engineer with strong web, backend, and systems experience, but has minimal recent C++ experience (a brief stint over a decade ago at National Instruments) and no demonstrated background in IoT protocols, MQTT, industrial cybersecurity/IEC 62443, message brokers, or the automation/industrial domain central to this role. His core expertise (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, Ember.js) does not align with the C++/STL, multi-threaded networked systems, and industrial security focus required.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across many domains
Demonstrated low-latency, high-performance systems work (DLang, async I/O, fibers, micro-services at Sociomantic)
Strong communication, mentoring, and teaching track record (workshops, talks, open-source leadership)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and outdated (only ~6 months in 2014-2015), not matching the 8-12 years of C++ expected
No evident experience with MQTT, REST-based IoT systems, message brokers, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, etc.)
No mention of IEC 62443, Secure Development Lifecycle, or industrial cybersecurity practices

key_factors.factor: Strong general senior-level engineering and system design skills
